name: European gas price spike
rationale: Wholesale gas (TTF) spikes. Retail gas and electricity follow slowly and partially because of regulated tariffs, fixed-term contracts and price caps, so the shock ramps in over 6 months. Size +20% on the retail level, about a quarter of the 2021–22 episode, when euro area electricity, gas and heat prices rose 75% from Jun 2021 to their peak (Eurostat).
sources: ECB Economic Bulletin boxes on retail energy pass-through
mapping: Judgemental: retail ELC_GAS +20% over 6 months (no TTF series in the pipeline)
